name: Caesar Displeased
msg: Word from Rome: Caesar is displeased with your governance. Tax inspectors arrive unannounced.

name: Frontier Trade Boom
msg: Caravans from the south arrive bearing coin — your loyalty to Rome has not gone unnoticed.

name: Iron Vein Exhausted
msg: The eastern iron vein gives its last ore. Miners look to the hills for new seams.
